capabilities.name: Public evidence manifest validation
capabilities.description: Builds and validates bounded metadata manifests and SHA-256 digests for caller-supplied public non-personal bytes.
limitations: Does not fetch or persist evidence and does not authenticate source or collector.

capabilities.name: Deterministic chain-of-custody event verification
capabilities.description: Creates and verifies ordered hash-linked evidence metadata events.
limitations: Hash chain is not a signature, trusted timestamp, immutable storage or legal chain-of-custody certification.

explicit_non_capabilities: Digital signatures, key custody or trusted timestamping
